When claiming atomic mutations, Alfred MUST implement an
atomic write/replace strategy that is correct on
Linux/macOS/Windows; if atomic replacement cannot be
guaranteed (e.g., locked destination on Windows), Alfred MUST
fail explicitly rather than partially applying changes.
